goal: Compact and clarify result count and sorting controls across every VII discovery world without changing search behavior

applicable_lessons.title: Public mobile screenshots are required release evidence

requirements.statement: Compact and clarify result count and sorting controls across every VII discovery world without changing search behavior
requirements.acceptance_check: Vacation, spa, event and hourly result toolbars pass mobile and desktop rendered checks; compact sort says only Recommended; selected option is readable
evidence: Built candidate renders compact counts and Recommended sort across vacations, events, spa, hourly and providers at 390px and 1280px; no page errors or horizontal overflow.

requirements.statement: Predict likely Adir rejection reasons and bind prevention to observable evidence before implementation.
requirements.acceptance_check: The bounded predictive manifest matches the task identity and selected lessons and passes deterministic validation.

requirements.statement: Attempt to disprove completion using the planned rejection questions at the natural destination and across the affected family.
requirements.acceptance_check: Record the attacks performed and the exact natural-destination and affected-family evidence that survived them.

Vacations, events, spa, hourly and providers all returned HTTP 200 with no page errors; focused tests 11/11 passed and pnpm build completed.

requirements.statement: Measure whether the proactive gate reduced repeated correction work for this task.
requirements.acceptance_check: Record first-pass acceptance state, repeated corrections, prevented failures, and elapsed time or a precise unavailable baseline.
evidence: Structured effectiveness result: first_pass=no, repeated_corrections=1, prevented_failures=3, elapsed_minutes=25.0; The first matrix exposed a SPA-only cascade conflict that shrank the trigger; one causal selector fix removed the mismatch before handoff.

requirements.statement: מסלול נייד מלא נבנה ונבדק בפני עצמו, לרבות המסך הראשון, צפיפות, קריאות, גלילה, חלונות, פעולות ומעברי רוחב.
requirements.acceptance_check: שער הראיות נכשל ללא צילום חי של המסך הראשון והמסלול המלא, בדיקת גובה נמוך, מדידת גלישה ומטריצת מעברי רוחב.
evidence: Rendered 390px and 360px mobile checks: result count is one or two lines, sort text is not clipped, and document overflow is zero.

requirements.statement: כל ממשק משתמש בהיררכיה נקייה ובקצב ריווח מדוד, ללא כותרות כפולות, טקסטי מילוי, קווים ללא תפקיד, מסגרות בתוך מסגרות, שטחים ריקים ללא סיבה או תוכן ובקרים הצמודים לגבולות.
requirements.acceptance_check: שער הראיות נכשל ללא אסימוני ריווח, מדידות של מעברים סמוכים, צילום עמוד מלא במחשב ובנייד, סריקת תוכן כפול ומלאי מסגרות וקווים שעברו בדיקה עצמאית.
evidence: Visual screenshots inspected for spa and hourly closed/open menus; selected option is white on dark teal and toolbar hierarchy is compact.

requirements.statement: A mobile search product is not visually approved until meaningful content is visible in the viewport and an independent checker inspects both a public-domain screenshot and the live page. DOM presence, text length, build output and overflow measurements alone are insufficient.
requirements.acceptance_check: A public Spa results route with an artificially empty results control must fail with no-visible-results-state or excessive-empty-band, and the report must contain a screenshot path inspected by the independent checker.
evidence: All five affected result families were inventoried and rendered on mobile and desktop rather than patching only the reported hourly page.

requirements.statement: All affected discovery worlds use the compact result toolbar treatment
requirements.acceptance_check: All affected discovery worlds use the compact result toolbar treatment
evidence: Playwright matrix: 10 route/viewport combinations returned 200, zero page errors, count max 2 lines, Rubik family, and full Recommended label.

requirements.statement: Sorting values, callbacks and result ordering remain functional
requirements.acceptance_check: Sorting values, callbacks and result ordering remain functional
evidence: Shared ModernSelect remains wired to the existing per-world onChange handlers; 11 focused contract tests pass and open-menu rendered state shows the current selected value.

Rendered /hourly at 390x844: count text נמצאו 52 מקומות measured 163.8x15px on one line, sort trigger measured 118x40px and displayed מומלצים, selected option computed white on teal gradient, document scrollWidth equaled viewport width 390; screenshot project_knowledge/diagnostics/results-toolbar-hourly-mobile-open.png
findings: The first rendered open menu exposed an additional narrow-menu truncation risk; widened only the open discovery sort menu while keeping the closed trigger compact.

attacks: Mobile flex compression could truncate Recommended in SPA; discriminating check caught 81px trigger and the final rule now holds 118px at 390 and 108px at 360.
Long result counts could exceed the toolbar; vacation count renders in two lines and all other sampled families in one.
Selected menu text could inherit dark ink on teal; computed color is rgb(255,255,255) in all five families.
A cross-world style change could cause horizontal scroll or serif fallback; all sampled pages have zero mobile overflow and Rubik-first computed fonts.
